privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ZenoPay collects, uses, stores, and protects your information when you use the app and related services.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Desc: We collect information that is needed to create and protect your account, provide wallet features, process purchases, and improve app security and support.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item1: Account details such as full name, email address, password or login information, city, country, phone number, gender, and date of birth when you create an account.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item2: Profile information such as profile photo, avatar, city, phone number, email, and other details you choose to add or update.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item3: Wallet and transaction information such as deposits, withdrawals, money transfers, balances, transaction history, and related records.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item4: Purchase and order information related to mobile shop, gift cards, top-up cards, and virtual card creation, including product details, order status, payment amount, and delivery-related information.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item5: Card information related to internal virtual card creation, including one-card-per-user setup and creation fee records such as 25,000 IQD where applicable.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item6: Additional account protection information such as selfie or document images, including ID front, ID back, and selfie, when needed to help protect accounts and reduce fraud or misuse of the platform.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item7: Location information may be used only to help suggest or display your city inside the mobile shop page. Users can still manually enter their city.
privacyPolicyPage.section1Item8: Support, password reset, security check, and account recovery information when you contact support or use account security features.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Desc: We use your information only for purposes related to operating, securing, and improving the app.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item1: To create, manage, and secure your account.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item2: To process deposits, withdrawals, wallet transfers, and other wallet activity.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item3: To process purchases from mobile shop, gift cards, top-up cards, and virtual card services.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item4: To display your profile information, account settings, and transaction history inside the app.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item5: To help protect accounts, review suspicious activity, and prevent fraud or misuse.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item6: To support password reset, login verification, and account recovery features.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item7: To improve app performance, user experience, and feature reliability.
privacyPolicyPage.section2Item8: To respond to support requests and communicate important service updates.
privacyPolicyPage.section3Desc: If you allow location access, ZenoPay may use it only to suggest or show your city in the mobile shop page. Location is not required for general app use, and users may manually enter their city instead.
privacyPolicyPage.section4Desc: We do not sell your personal information. Some information may be processed using secure service providers or internal admin tools only when needed to operate the app, provide support, store account data, process orders, or maintain security.
privacyPolicyPage.section5Desc: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to help protect your account and information. No system can guarantee absolute security, but we work to reduce unauthorized access, misuse, and loss of data.
privacyPolicyPage.section6Desc: We retain information for as long as needed to operate the app, maintain wallet and order records, protect accounts, resolve disputes, meet legal obligations, and improve service reliability.
privacyPolicyPage.section7Desc: You may review or update parts of your account information inside the app. You may also contact support regarding account information, security issues, or other privacy-related requests.
privacyPolicyPage.section8Desc: Some app features may rely on secure external services such as hosting, authentication, storage, notifications, or app infrastructure providers. These services may process data only as needed to support app functionality.
privacyPolicyPage.section9Desc: ZenoPay is intended for users aged 18 and above.
privacyPolicyPage.section10Desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, the updated version will appear in the app with a revised last updated date.
privacyPolicyPage.section11Desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your information, please contact us at:

terms.intro: Welcome to ZenoPay. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully.
terms.section1Item1: By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.
terms.section1Item2: You must be at least 18 years old to use ZenoPay.
terms.section1Item3: You agree to provide accurate and complete information.

terms.section3Item2: The app may also include mobile shop, gift cards, top-up cards, travel information, consulate information, and internal virtual card features.

terms.section5Item3: Wallet balances, fees, prices, and availability may change from time to time.
terms.section6Item1: ZenoPay may provide an internal virtual card feature for supported services.
terms.section6Item2: Virtual card creation may include a one-time creation fee such as 25,000 IQD if shown in the app.
terms.section6Item3: Certain users may be limited to one virtual card per account.
terms.section7Title: Mobile Shop, Gift Cards, and Top-Up
terms.section7Item1: Product names, images, prices, stock, installment options, and delivery information may change or be updated inside the app.
terms.section7Item2: You are responsible for checking product details before placing an order.
terms.section7Item3: Orders may be reviewed, delayed, completed, or cancelled depending on availability, account status, payment status, or safety checks.
terms.section8Desc: If you allow location access, the app may use it only to help suggest your city in the mobile shop page. You may also enter your city manually.
terms.section9Item1: To help protect accounts and reduce misuse, we may request additional information such as a selfie or document images in some situations.
terms.section9Item2: Submitting additional information does not guarantee account approval, access to a feature, or uninterrupted service.
terms.section9Item3: You must not submit false, edited, or misleading information.
terms.section10Item1: You must not use the app for fraud, abuse, unlawful activity, or attempts to bypass platform safety.
terms.section10Item2: You must not interfere with the app, servers, payment flows, security systems, or other users.
terms.section10Item3: You must not misuse promotions, orders, balances, or system errors.
terms.section11Item1: We may suspend, restrict, review, or close accounts when suspicious, unsafe, abusive, or policy-violating activity is detected.
terms.section11Item2: We may also limit access to some features while a review or security check is in progress.
terms.section11Item3: Some records may be kept for operational, safety, support, or legal reasons.
terms.section12Item1: Some app features may connect to third-party services, providers, or information sources.
terms.section12Item2: Those services may have their own rules, privacy policies, availability, and limitations.
terms.section12Item3: We are not responsible for interruptions, changes, or losses caused by third-party services beyond our reasonable control.
terms.section13Item1: We aim to provide a reliable service, but we do not guarantee that the app will always be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times.
terms.section13Item2: To the extent allowed by law, ZenoPay is not responsible for indirect or unexpected losses caused by outages, delays, external providers, user mistakes, or events outside our reasonable control.
terms.section13Item3: Your use of the app is at your own responsibility, subject to applicable law.
terms.section14Item1: Your use of the app is also subject to our Privacy Policy.
terms.section14Item2: By using the app, you agree to how information is collected, used, and protected as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.section15Item1: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time.

terms.section15Item3: Your continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated terms.
